cleared.description: One pen handwriting row, saved, then "Clear ink from this page" from the eraser settings and confirmed. This is the page as saved after the clear.

highlighter.description: One black pen line, then the highlighter (default yellow and thickness): a long stroke below the line and a short upright stroke crossing the pen line.

pen-colours.description: Pen at its default thickness: one handwriting row in red, then one in green, picked from the pen settings colour presets.

pen-pressure.description: Pen at 50% thickness with an iPad user agent (which turns pressure on): one handwriting row with pressure rising 0.2 to 0.9, one with pressure rising and falling.
pen-pressure.userAgent: Mozilla/5.0 (iPad; CPU OS 17_5 like Mac OS X) AppleWebKit/605.1.15 (KHTML, like Gecko) Version/17.5 Mobile/15E148 Safari/604.1
pen-pressure.pressureSent: 0.2 to 0.9, as a ramp up and as a rise and fall
pen-pressure.pressureNote: Pressure reached the page. Whether the editor applied it shows in the saved shapes, as outlines that widen and narrow.

pen-straight-line.description: Pen at 40% thickness: one nearly straight stroke, then the pen held still for 1.5s before lifting, with the default Straighten and level setting, so it should snap to a line.
pen-straight-line.straightenNote: Inspect the saved path: a snapped line has far fewer points than the 40 sent.

pen-thick.description: Pen at 85% thickness: one handwriting row and one long, nearly straight stroke.

pen-thin.description: Pen at 20% thickness: two handwriting rows, one letter loop, and a single dot (pen down and up at one point, no moves).

precision-erased.description: One long pen stroke (default thickness), then the eraser in precision mode at medium size, dragged straight down through its middle so the stroke splits in two.
